dedupe_keys.name: convlstm based daily snow water equivalent swe predictions in the alps

description: The STARS4Water team deposits daily snow-water-equivalent grids for the Alps from a ConvLSTM model and a LISFLOOD comparison. The own page says the model uses ERA5-Land and EMO1 forcing and describes a one-arcminute grid, roughly 1.5 km at EFAS latitudes. Two public NetCDFs are named for an ERA5-driven 2010 to 2016 series and a LISFLOOD-labelled 2020 to 2024 series; together they exceed 7 GB. Zenodo marks the deposit CC BY 4.0. An Alpine hydrology or reservoir simulation could compare seasonal snow storage across the two model-derived products. The differing filename periods mean this is not automatically a paired same-day validation series. The page also uses `1km` in filenames while describing one arcminute, so the actual resolution is uncertain. Units, missing-value conventions and the LISFLOOD series' role were not verified because no NetCDF was opened. No related catalogue record covers this release.
name: ConvLSTM-based Daily Snow Water Equivalent (SWE) Predictions in the Alps
notes: G6 item G6-2324. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
